origin_lemma.etymology: 10191 muṇḍa¹ 'shaved, bald, lopped' MBh., 'hornless' VarBr̥S., 'blunt' Kathās., m. = °aka- m. 'trunk of lopped tree' lex. [Prob. of Drav. origin (A. Master BSOAS xii 354) with coalescence of two Drav. wordgroups (DED 4199, 4200); less likely Mu. connexions (J. Przyluski BSL xxx 199, PMWS 102). Not with P. Thieme ZDMG 93, 134 < *mr̥ṁṣṭa- nor with P. Tedesco JAOS 65, 82 < vr̥ddha-² 'cut'. In IA. it forms part of 'defective' word-group s.v. *muṭṭa-¹ with all variations characteristic of such groups. — Cf. *muṇḍa-² 'lump']
